def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    ebit = 1106
    tax_rate = 0.32
    depreciation = 243
    fixed_capital_investment = 535

    current_assets_2012 = 1290
    current_liabilities_2012 = 2783
    current_assets_2011 = 1199
    current_liabilities_2011 = 2678

    net_working_capital_2012 = current_assets_2012 - current_liabilities_2012
    net_working_capital_2011 = current_assets_2011 - current_liabilities_2011
    investment_in_working_capital = (
        net_working_capital_2012 - net_working_capital_2011
    )

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    fcff = (
        ebit * (1 - tax_rate)
        + depreciation
        - fixed_capital_investment
        - investment_in_working_capital
    )

    # Return answer rounded to three decimal places
    return round(fcff, 3)
